summary: Death Flies East is a 1935 American mystery film directed by Phil Rosen and starring Conrad Nagel, Florence Rice and Raymond Walburn. Its action takes place aboard an airline flight with a murderer on board. The note describes it as an early example of the aviation "disaster film" genre.
one_line: A 1935 American mystery film directed by Phil Rosen, set on an airline flight with a murderer aboard.
